versions.changelog:
- Initial release of seo-page skill for deep, single-page SEO analysis.
- Audits on-page SEO elements, content quality, technical meta tags, schema markup, images, and performance signals.
- Organized, actionable output: scorecard, prioritized issues, tailored recommendations, and schema suggestions.
- Handles DataForSEO integration for SERP and backlink checks, if available.
- Robust error handling for unreachable URLs, authentication blocks, and JS-rendered pages.
